description: Sequential program pipeline. Each stage produces artifacts consumed by the next. Some stages may run multiple teammates in parallel.

stages.name: Foundation and Artifact Contract
stages.completionSignal: artifact contract, team config, and lead prompt approved

stages.name: Repository Ingestion and Reverse Engineering
stages.completionSignal: repo can produce symbol graph, dependency graph, and pseudocode ledger

stages.name: Diagram and Contract Synthesis
stages.completionSignal: selected diagrams and ledgers can be generated for the pilot repo

stages.name: Migration Planning and Target Mapping
stages.completionSignal: gap matrix and target mapping created for pilot migration

stages.name: Dashboard MVP
stages.completionSignal: operator can navigate architecture, migration, work orders, and evidence views

stages.name: Collaboration Server and Shared Repository
stages.completionSignal: shared projects, artifacts, approvals, and evidence modeled and implemented

stages.name: Pilot, Verify, Release
stages.completionSignal: pilot packet and verifier evidence complete; release packet prepared
